description: This file provides service functions for managing repair requests, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting requests. It supports both in-memory mock data and real database interactions via Supabase, with functions to handle data normalization and filtering.

methods.name: listRepairRequests
methods.description: Lists repair requests, optionally filtered by query and status, using in-memory data or Supabase.

methods.name: createRepairRequest
methods.description: Creates a new repair request, either in-memory or in the database.

methods.name: updateRepairRequest
methods.description: Updates an existing repair request identified by ID, either in-memory or in the database.

methods.name: deleteRepairRequest
methods.description: Deletes a repair request by ID, either in-memory or in the database.
